pre_build: rm -rf wasm-dist && mkdir -p 'wasm-dist/helm-data/patches' && cp -r 'src/dsp/helm/patches/Factory Presets' wasm-dist/helm-data/patches/ && mkdir -p 'wasm-dist/helm-data/patches/Factory Presets/Keys' && cp 'data/Move Organ.helm' 'wasm-dist/helm-data/patches/Factory Presets/Keys/'

mkdir -p wasm-gen && printf '%s\n' '/* schwung-wasm: JUCE_WASM declares these (juce_ApplicationBase.cpp) but only the Linux/mac juce_Files_* define them. */' 'namespace juce { const char* const* juce_argv = nullptr; int juce_argc = 0; }' > wasm-gen/juce_wasm_argv.cpp
upstream_build: CMakeLists.txt: C++17, mopo/*.cpp + synthesis/*.cpp + juce_core/events/audio_basics/data_structures + helm common + helm_plugin.cpp, -DLINUX=1 -DJUCE_HEADLESS=1 ...; dist/helm/{module.json,help.json,LICENSE,ui.js,dsp.so,helm-data/patches/Factory Presets (+Keys/Move Organ.helm)}
wasm_notes: Built without upstream's -DLINUX=1 so JUCE 8.0.10 takes its JUCE_WASM platform path (Linux native headers like sys/prctl.h/sys/ptrace.h don't exist in Emscripten); LINUX only selected fallback patch/config dirs and the plugin sets its bank dir explicitly. Patch 0001 fills JUCE_WASM gaps (ThreadPriorities table, PropertiesFile default dir, emscripten.h include). -Dschwung_wasm_pthread_setaffinity_np(t,n,s)=0 works around compat/include/schwung_module_prelude.h renaming pthread_setaffinity_np to a symbol the current wasm_compat.h no longer defines (shared-infra bug; drop once fixed). pre_build generates wasm-gen/juce_wasm_argv.cpp defining juce::juce_argc/juce_argv (declared but undefined on JUCE_WASM).
skip_reason: Compiles (1.8 MB side module) but dlopen fails: JUCE 8.0.10's JUCE_WASM target has no native implementations for 59 juce_core/juce_events symbols helm links (DirectoryIterator::NativeIterator, File::getSpecialLocation, Thread::createNativeThread, MessageManager platform hooks, sockets/WebInputStream/NamedPipe/ChildProcess). Next step: compile JUCE as JUCE_LINUX with stub headers for sys/prctl.h, sys/ptrace.h, sys/timerfd.h, sys/sysinfo.h (POSIX natives mostly work on Emscripten), or add a small wasm natives file (dir iteration + pthread thread + no-op message queue). Realistic with ~half a day.
